_note: Pinned knowledge snapshot of the A2A protocol used by a2aops. Update this file (and the version pin) when the spec moves; do not scatter spec facts through code.

migration_v03_to_v10.detail: v1.0 discovery path is /.well-known/agent-card.json. Keep the old path as a redirect during migration, then retire it.
migration_v03_to_v10.title: Card moved from /.well-known/agent.json to /.well-known/agent-card.json

migration_v03_to_v10.detail: Each entry needs url, protocolBinding (JSONRPC | GRPC | HTTP+JSON) and protocolVersion. The first entry is the preferred endpoint.
migration_v03_to_v10.title: url + preferredTransport replaced by supportedInterfaces

migration_v03_to_v10.detail: Every skill must declare tags; routers use them for skill-level task matching.
migration_v03_to_v10.title: AgentSkill.tags is now mandatory

migration_v03_to_v10.detail: v0.x lowercase strings (submitted, input-required, ...) must be normalized at the client edge. The v0.x 'unknown' state is gone; use TASK_STATE_UNSPECIFIED (and treat it as a protocol violation).
migration_v03_to_v10.title: Task states are SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE TASK_STATE_* on the wire

migration_v03_to_v10.detail: Declare every scheme you enforce in securitySchemes and require it in securityRequirements; undeclared enforcement is the classic auth-drift failure.
migration_v03_to_v10.title: securitySchemes + securityRequirements are the declared auth surface
